title: 【第6回】Codexのコード評価から、View分割・描画改善・CI導入へ
summary: tyamada22 follows a Codex code review through a staged plan for narrower SwiftUI views, testable page grouping, rendering caches, documentation rules, and CI. An iOS team can turn agent findings into explicit completion conditions and inspect actual workflow scope; the account separates Pages publishing from app tests, records a missing-file CI failure, and leaves cache sizing unvalidated.
takeaway: Protect behavior before refactoring, define cache keys and limits explicitly, and verify which branches and checks a CI workflow actually runs.
